description: The core's own risk: prior from shape, counts, pressure, risk.max.

cases.description: with no counts, risk is the prior from each type's shape; demand is 0; no shape is 8
risk.max removes a place whose prior is above it, before any try
a place exactly at risk.max is kept
every try and every busy answer is counted at its place
a place often busy is riskier: prior × (1 + busy ÷ (tries + 5))
machine-months with no loss bring the prior down
losses raise the estimate past the prior
the hours of running machines count, before they leave
a lost machine counts, with the hours it ran
a machine the core ends counts its hours, never as lost
risk.max removes a place the counts make risky
